title: Step 03 - US-SEC-03: Self-Service Password Recovery & Email Reset
description:
User Story:
As a Registered User,
I want to request a password reset link sent to my registered email address,
So that I can securely recover my account if I forget my password.

Legacy Source: AccountController.cs (ForgotPassword, ResetPassword), SendGrid API
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Submitting valid email sends time-limited, single-use cryptographic reset token.
2. Reset password link validates token expiration (24 hours).
3. Resetting password updates password hash and revokes prior active sessions.
4. Email delivery integrated via modern email client.
